gaps.reason: Only abort-aware local mocks and jsdom were executed. TCP/TLS disconnects, real ReadableStream lock release, sockets/FD return, browser lifecycle and OS networking were not measured. releaseLock/cancel counters are zero, not proof of real resource leak or leak freedom.

1000 compiler inputs, 512-line hook bursts and 8 concurrent hooks are bounded experiments. No hard ingress cap, production throughput, browser scheduler pressure, heap plateau after forced GC, descriptor growth or RSS plateau was proved. Growth without reset is inferred from source after observed proportional samples, not a measured infinite execution.
Solid/Vue/Svelte/React Native callers are acknowledged from saved caller review, not dynamically exercised. No cross-framework pass is claimed.

No authorized live API, DB or persistence substrate. Mock callback/sink partitions demonstrate local ordering only, not external rollback, exactly-once delivery, server-side generation/billing idempotence or recovery after remote commit.

Frozen destination, throwing accessor/setter and unrelated cycle are forced. Arbitrary Proxies, getter-triggered reentrant mutation, touched cycles, massive nesting, allocation failure/OOM and hostile prototypes are not exhaustively exercised; no generalized transactional safety claim.

Author identity and author/reviewer model identities/families are unknown. Local/native execution is not cross-family independence. Contract and direct state/callback oracles are evidence, not an independent model-family review.
